name: NeuronWriter
description_en:
NEURONwriter combines search-oriented content analysis, editing, AI generation and AI-visibility monitoring. A user starts with a target query, inspects competing content and uses suggestions to prepare or improve a page. Its score describes the tool’s recommendations, not a measured ranking result.

The current product adds monitored questions across AI services and API/MCP-related workflows on eligible tiers. These are distinct from writing an article and have separate allowances. NEURONwriter is described as part of CONTADU, not interchangeable with every product in that family.
description_zh:
NEURONwriter 结合搜索内容分析、编辑、AI 生成及 AI 可见性监测，从目标查询出发，检查竞品内容并据建议准备或改进页面。分数反映工具建议，不是测得排名。

现行产品增加 AI 服务问题监测及符合层级的 API/MCP 流程，和写文章不同、额度也不同。它属于 CONTADU，不代表家族全部产品互通。

core_features.explanation_en: Analyze a target query and use editor recommendations for a draft.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分析目标查询，再用编辑建议起草。

core_features.explanation_en: Monitor a limited question set and access eligible publication/API tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 监测有限问题，并访问符合套餐的发布/API 工具。

en: Improve a factual installation guide using relevant query suggestions and checked links.
zh: 使用相关查询建议与已核链接改进真实安装指南。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose one query, validate recommendations against primary documentation and inspect the draft/export before connecting live publishing.
steps.zh: 选择查询、用原始文档核建议，连接正式发布前检查初稿/导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Tiered project/document/AI-credit and monitoring allowances, with optional external model costs.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Monthly display Bronze $23, Silver $45, Gold $69, Platinum $93, Diamond $117 with separate yearly figures. Capacity includes projects/documents/AI credits/monitored questions. Seven-day Gold trial; own key/integrations/API from eligible tier. Advanced-monitoring $0 placeholder is not a confirmed add-on quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 月展示 Bronze $23、Silver $45、Gold $69、Platinum $93、Diamond $117，另列年价，容量包括项目/文档/AI 额度/监测问题。七天 Gold 试用，自有 key/集成/API 有层级条件，高级监测 $0 占位不是确定报价。

sources.title: NEURONwriter – AI Visibility, Rank on Google
sources.research_notes_en: Content optimization and AI visibility platform in CONTADU family, with editor scores, term suggestions, generation and integrations; no ranking outcome verified.

sources.title: Pricing Neuron - NEURONwriter: Content Optimization & AI Visibility Platform
sources.research_notes_en: Project/document/AI-credit/monitored-question tiers, seven-day Gold trial, own-key and API/MCP from Gold; displayed monthly versus annual amounts and add-on placeholder.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Optimize for the reader before chasing a score
sections.en: For an illustrative installation guide, choose the intended query and compare suggested terms with real product documentation. Add only relevant facts; a competitor mention is not evidence that your product has that feature. Check citations, internal links and instructions after AI insertion. A higher content score is not proof of helpfulness, rank or AI citation, and none of those outcomes was tested.
sections.zh: 例如安装指南，应选择预期查询，并把建议术语与真实产品文档比较，只加相关事实。竞品提及不证明本品具备该功能，AI 插入后需核引用、内链及步骤。分数提高不证明有帮助、排名或 AI 引用，本文均未测。

sections.title_en: Separate projects, documents, AI credits and questions
sections.title_zh: 区分项目、文档、AI 额度与问题
sections.en: Bronze lists $23/month, two projects, twenty-five documents, five monitored questions and 15,000 AI credits. Gold lists $69, ten projects, seventy-five documents, ten questions and 45,000 credits, plus team/integration features. Silver, Platinum and Diamond raise different limits. Yearly figures are separately displayed; verify the selected billing and reset periods. Gold’s own-key option may shift model costs to an external provider rather than make generation free.
sections.zh: Bronze 列月 $23、2 项目、25 文档、5 监测问题和 15,000 AI 额度；Gold $69、10 项目、75 文档、10 问题、45,000 额度及团队/集成。Silver、Platinum、Diamond 提升不同上限，另列年价，需核账期及重置。Gold 自有 key 可能把模型费转给外部提供商，并非免费生成。

sections.title_en: Interpret AI visibility as a sampled measurement
sections.title_zh: 把 AI 可见性理解为采样测量
sections.en: The page names Google AI features, ChatGPT and Perplexity monitoring and displays an advanced add-on at $0 pending login. That placeholder is not a quote for arbitrary extra questions or models. Confirm prompts, frequency, region and history before comparing trends. A seven-day trial uses Gold terms; the first-plan refund request is described within thirty days, not an independently exercised guarantee.
sections.zh: 页面列 Google AI、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 监测，高级附加项在登录前显示 $0，这不是任意更多问题或模型报价。比较趋势前需核提示、频率、地区和历史。七天试用按 Gold 条件，首个付费套餐三十天内申请退款是文档描述，未实际验证。

sections.en: NEURONwriter merits investigation for editorial teams using query analysis alongside factual expertise. Connectors, own keys and API/MCP require suitable credentials and scope. Test a nonpublic draft and export before any production write. No ranking, monitoring result, plagiarism check, connector or model call was executed; source license, self-hosting and contract data handling remain unverified.
sections.zh: 编辑团队在事实专业知识之外需要查询分析时可研究该工具。连接、自有 key 和 API/MCP 需适当凭据及范围，生产写入前先测试非公开稿与导出。本文未执行排名、监测、抄袭检查、连接或模型调用，源码许可、自托管及合同数据处理未核实。

research_gaps: No editor, AI generation, visibility sample, plagiarism check, own-key call, integration or publication was tested.
Currency, allowance reset, document definition, add-on price, provider costs, data terms, license and self-hosting remain unverified.
